notes: Customize has a Save button: try looks on, then save the ones you want. Leaving without saving puts back what you had. Looks you don't own yet show on your robot too, marked with a padlock, and each slot lists its two free looks first. The page also opens at the top again.
Google Play: if a purchase went through but couldn't be confirmed yet, the button says "Unlock your purchase" and checks it again, instead of Google saying you already own it.
Epic Games Store: the Supporter Pack is an add-on, bought on its store page. It unlocks the next time you start Blitzbreak from the Epic Games Launcher.
The icon beside each player's name is now their store's own: Steam, Epic Games, Google Play Games, and Game Center on Apple devices.
